judgeIssues.detail: Source label 'Order' rendered as 'inleg' (deposit/stake), which both mistranslates the concept and collides with the run's other renderings that keep 'order' in English ('{{amount}} order' i2177, 'Order {{n}}' i2261, 'Orders' i2845/2909). Intra-run term collision on a financial label.

evidence.rule: Intra-slice term collision — same source term must have one rendering

judgeIssues.detail: 'Inleg' means a deposited stake, not an order; a user could believe this column shows their deposit rather than an order.
